object.attr: analysis: an agent must not take a missing item for an empty answer, and the name shows which of several IDs was wrong (TRACE review). On a write tool the `error_type` is `EditorError` (MELLON-MCP-SRS-53); on other tools it is open (MELLON-MCP-SRS-55).
object.description: If a tool call names a document or object that doesn't exist, the MCP server shall return `ok` false and an `error` naming the document or object.
